build_image_preprocessor: build an ImagePreprocessor Haiku module to preprocess images using conv, patches, or pixels mode with positional encoding
build_image_postprocessor: build an ImagePostprocessor Haiku module to upsample and reconstruct images from Perceiver latent representations
build_multimodal_preprocessor: build a MultimodalPreprocessor to preprocess multiple modalities and pad them to a common channel size with masking support
build_multimodal_postprocessor: build a MultimodalPostprocessor to slice and postprocess outputs for each modality from a Perceiver model
build_embedding_decoder: build an EmbeddingDecoder Haiku module to decode embeddings into vocabulary logits using a given embedding matrix
